title: LoL Esports |
content:
Welcome to the LCS Promotion Tournament! Tier-2 teams have been battling throughout the year where only one challenge remains. The stakes couldn’t be higher as the LCS Promotion Tournament will determine which team earns the coveted LCS Guest Slot for the 2027 season. Only the top two NACL and LRN teams will advance to face the defending Guest Team, Disguised. Disguised successfully fought off all opposing challengers in 2026. The question is, can they do it again?

Across seven days, all five teams will compete in a double-elimination bracket featuring Full Fearless, First Selection, Best-of-Fives. The defending Guest Team will enter with a bracket advantage but must still win their spot—no automatic requalification. All matches begin at 1pm PDT.

This year, we’re thrilled to partner with LYON to produce the LCS Promotion Tournament fresh off of the LCS Homegrounds. The first six days of the tournament will be played remotely similar to last year, but we’re excited to introduce a live audience LAN Finals hosted by LYON at the Arena Esports Stadium at CINEMEX Artz Pedregal in Mexico City, Mexico. In order to ensure a competitive tournament during the remote stage, LRN teams, where necessary, will be provided flights, hotels, and practice rooms in Mexico City for the duration of the tournament.

The tournament winner secures the LCS Guest Slot, granting the right to compete in the LCS and qualify for major global events, including First Stand, MSI, and Worlds. The Guest Slot also comes with financial support: an operating stipend, access to the Global Revenue Pool from LoL Esports in-game content sales, and the same business model benefits as Tier-1 teams.

To catch all of the action live, stay tuned starting October 5 onTwitch.tv/LCSandYouTube.com/@LCS.

In case you missed it, we also recently announced a brand new international Tier-2 Tournament called theWorld Star Challengers Invitational. The article has the full tournament details, but we’re excited to provide the NACL Summer Split Champion a qualification spot as the Tier-2 representative from North America.

title: League of Legends adds voice chat
summary: League of Legends adds voice chat  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Plug in your mics and get ready to flame your jungler, in voice!

Riot Games has finally unveiled details on team voice chat for League of Legends. The feature will be available in select servers beginningOct. 7, with a gradual, planned rollout to other servers following that.

First, players requireat least Honor Level 3to be able to use the system. This will come with a refinement to the Honor system to better reflect in-game behavior.

League Team Voice will also offer a voice changer called “voice skins.” The initial ones will be free, since they also double as toxicity mitigation on top of being an avenue for personalization. In the long-term, we may see paid ones, though.

Finally, push-to-talk isrequired. This garnered manynegative reactions online, with players stating that League of Legends is already a busy game when it comes to key bindings. With push-to-talk as a mandatory setting, it will be difficult to communicate with the team during teamfights, where coordination is most crucial.
